purpose: Machine-addressable relationship schema for evidence, domain facts, primitives, reusable rule families, generated execution logic, client binding and runtime projection.

edgeTypes.DERIVES_FROM: Source node is supported/generated from target evidence/fact.
edgeTypes.INSTANTIATES: Generated logic instantiates a semantic primitive.
edgeTypes.SPECIALIZES: Target is a broader semantic/rule construct specialized by source/scope.
edgeTypes.COMPOSES_WITH: Source and target jointly contribute to execution behavior.
edgeTypes.DEPENDS_ON: Source cannot execute/resolve correctly without target outcome.
edgeTypes.ACTIVATES: Source condition causes target requirement/logic to become applicable.
edgeTypes.CONSTRAINS: Source restricts target values, role, cardinality, representation or behavior.
edgeTypes.RESOLVES_WITH: Source requires target master/reference/related object for resolution.
edgeTypes.OVERRIDES_WITHIN_SCOPE: Source specialization changes behavior only in declared scope.
edgeTypes.PRECEDES: Source must be resolved/executed before target.
edgeTypes.CORROBORATES: Source supports but does not independently establish target canonical truth.
edgeTypes.CONFLICTS_WITH: Source and target make incompatible claims requiring governed resolution.
edgeTypes.COEXISTS_AS_DISTINCT_SEMANTIC: Different values/objects are valid because they represent different semantics.
edgeTypes.ROUTES_TO: Failure/condition routes source outcome to target exception/queue.
edgeTypes.PROJECTS_TO: Canonical execution logic translates to target runtime projection.
edgeTypes.BLOCKED_BY: Source cannot be completed because target gap/dependency is unresolved.

invariants: Every generated rule instance must DERIVE_FROM at least one evidence or governed domain fact.
Every generated rule instance must INSTANTIATE at least one semantic primitive.
Every generated rule instance must COMPOSE_WITH or SPECIALIZE at least one rule family.
Every automatic mutation/correction rule must be traceable to source authority and preserve original source evidence.
Every multi-family behavior must use typed edges; a flat family list is insufficient.
Client bindings may OVERRIDE_WITHIN_SCOPE but must not rewrite canonical domain truth.
Runtime projections may PROJECT_FROM canonical logic but must not introduce canonical domain semantics.
Conflicting evidence must remain traceable until resolved by explicit source-authority/lifecycle logic.
Evidence is referenced through stable IDs and is not cloned per family.
Bidirectional traversal must be possible from evidence to downstream generated logic and from generated logic back to evidence.
